notes: Wix site with ~150 gallery images, the large majority being renovated bedroom/bathroom interiors of the cottages and dorm. Grounds photos are a 2019 HDR series that matches the former Presentation Center campus (white stucco buildings, labyrinth, redwood amphitheater). Site confirms 66 acres, 102-bed dormitory building, dining hall capacity 120, multiple meeting rooms (Cavanaugh Room etc.), amphitheater, labyrinth, pool, bocce, archery, hiking trail. A lake/pond photo (DSC01064) on the retreats page was skipped because it could not be confirmed as on-site. Wix originals are served without transforms; 06 is a 3941x2627 original.
